about: Critically acclaimed Ninja Legends brings you blood pumping, fast-paced, gory combat that works up a sweat.
Hone your abilities with unique ninja weapons like katanas, claws, and the staff and by paring weapons you can unleash devastating special attacks.

The gameplay rewards skillful blocking and parrying to fend off increasingly difficult enemy Ninja attacks. As enemy Ninja’s swarm and surround you, increase your rewards with slashes and attacks of great pace and accuracy, slicing up enemies as they advance.
To advance through all the levels you must learn the proper rhythm and timing in which to execute blocks, parries, melee attacks and ranged attacks. In other words, you must become a Ninja Legend!
Ninja Legends was crafted for VR from the ground up and offers a uniquely fast-paced melee combat experience only possible with VR.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
